title: Committee of Supply − Head X (Ministry of Culture, Community and Youth)
what_it_is: Committee of Supply − Head X (Ministry of Culture, Community and Youth)

sections.label: CNN report on American division
sections.summary: A CNN report says eight in 10 Americans believe their country is more divided on major issues than a few years ago.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lim Wee Kiak (Sembawang)
sentences.text: According to a Cable News Network (CNN) report, eight in 10 Americans now believe their country is more divided on major issues compared to a few years ago.

sections.label: Queues at Parliament House tribute
sections.summary: Over 440,000 people queued for hours at Parliament House, and others paid respects at 18 community tribute sites.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lim Wee Kiak (Sembawang)
sentences.text: More than 440,000 people queued for hours to pay their last respects at Parliament House and many others did that at the 18 community tribute sites.

sections.label: MCCY unity and trust strategies
sections.summary: MCCY is asked how it will bring citizens closer, strengthen trust, and keep Singapore united in adversity.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lim Wee Kiak (Sembawang)
sentences.text: How does the Ministry of Culture, Community and Youth (MCCY) intend to bring citizens closer together and strengthen that trust and the bridge that we have?

sentences.speaker: Dr Lim Wee Kiak (Sembawang)
sentences.text: What are the strategies to ensure that we remain united in the face of adversity?

sections.label: Focused assistance for particular group
sections.summary: The speaker says this group needs more focused and meaningful assistance such as advice, counselling and networking opportunities.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad (Chua Chu Kang)
sentences.text: In my opinion, for this particular group, there is a need for a more focused and meaningful assistance, for instance, by providing advice, counselling and networking opportunities.

sections.label: Reserved Presidential Election for Malays
sections.summary: The Prime Minister announced the upcoming Presidential Elections will be reserved for Malays, which the speaker says compromises meritocracy.

sentences.speaker: Mr Muhamad Faisal Bin Abdul Manap (Aljunied)
sentences.text: During the same debate, the Prime Minister announced that the upcoming Presidential Elections will be reserved for Malays.

sentences.speaker: Mr Muhamad Faisal Bin Abdul Manap (Aljunied)
sentences.text: The decision taken to reserve the Presidential Election for Malays, to me and also to many others, undeniably compromises the principle of meritocracy.

sentences.speaker: Mr Muhamad Faisal Bin Abdul Manap (Aljunied)
sentences.text: For instance, there are still concerns among our community about Malay/Muslim individuals not being given equal opportunities to hold the rank of General in the army or a Permanent Secretary in a Ministry.

sections.label: Muslim community education and upskilling efforts
sections.summary: Philanthropic organisations, mosques and self-help groups have dedicated efforts to education and upskilling, and a new MENDAKI division was welcomed.

sentences.speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
sentences.text: The Muslim community understands this aspect and, as such, efforts by philanthropic organisations, mosques and self-help groups, like the Family Excellence Circles and MENDAKI Social Enterprise Network Singapore Pte Ltd (SENSE), have been dedicated towards education and upskilling.

sentences.speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
sentences.text: Additionally, the creation of a MENDAKI division to promote SkillsFuture for Malay/Muslims was met with great interest from the community who welcomed it.

sections.label: Quality Service Unit and case management
sections.summary: A Quality Service Unit will aim for prompt replies and positive Court user experience, and a Differentiated Case Management Process will attend to family violence cases.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam (Jurong)
sentences.text: The Minister-in-charge of Muslim Affairs, Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim, spoke about the establishment of a Quality Service Unit that will strive to ensure that every query will receive a prompt reply and Court users will have a positive experience.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam (Jurong)
sentences.text: In addition, there is also the "Differentiated Case Management Process" where certain cases involving family violence will receive attention.

sections.label: Mandatory Asatizah Recognition Scheme implementation
sections.summary: The Minister announced the Mandatory Asatizah Recognition Scheme will be implemented from January this year to ensure religious guidance and training providers are qualified.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: (In Malay):   Madam, last year, the Minister announced that the Mandatory Asatizah Recognition Scheme (ARS) will be implemented from January this year.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: This scheme can help to ensure that those who offer religious guidance and training are qualified to do so.

sections.label: Quota of 400 students
sections.summary: The passage asks whether the quota of 400 students per cohort is adequate to fulfil the religious needs of the Malay/Muslim community.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zainal Sapari (Pasir Ris-Punggol)
sentences.text: Could the Minister, therefore, share whether the quota of 400 students per cohort is adequate to fulfil the religious needs of the Malay/Muslim community?

sections.label: MBMF increase and mosque openings
sections.summary: The passage asks how the increased MBMF contributions spurred mosque construction and upgrading, and when the Yusof Ishak Mosque will officially open.

sentences.speaker: Mr Amrin Amin (Sembawang)
sentences.text: (In Malay):   The Muslim community's monthly contributions to the Mosque Building and MENDAKI Fund (MBMF) was reviewed and increased last year.

sentences.speaker: Mr Amrin Amin (Sembawang)
sentences.text: Can the Minister clarify how the increase has spurred the construction and upgrading of mosques to fulfil the community's socio-religious needs?

sentences.speaker: Mr Amrin Amin (Sembawang)
sentences.text: Last year, our community celebrated the construction of the Maarof Mosque in Jurong West.

sentences.speaker: Mr Amrin Amin (Sembawang)
sentences.text: This year, we are looking forward to the opening of the Yusof Ishak Mosque in Woodlands.

sentences.speaker: Mr Amrin Amin (Sembawang)
sentences.text: Can the Minister inform us when the Yusof Ishak Mosque will be officially opened?

sections.label: Last amended in 2009
sections.summary: The passage states that the last time it was amended was in 2009.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: The last time it was amended was in 2009.

sections.label: MENDAKI SENSE PMET support committee
sections.summary: MENDAKI SENSE will step up efforts for PMETs, and two Parliamentary Secretaries will co-Chair a new committee to help lower-middle income PMETs.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
sentences.text: MENDAKI SENSE will step up its efforts for PMETs to better prepare against employment setbacks.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
sentences.text: In this regard, Madam, I have asked Parliamentary Secretaries Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim and Mr Amrin Amin to lead this important task.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
sentences.text: They will co-Chair a new committee to help lower-middle income PMETs.

sections.label: Malay SkillsFuture Credits usage
sections.summary: As of December 2016, only 8.4% of 126,000 Singaporean Malays had used their SkillsFuture Credits.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
sentences.text: As of December 2016, out of 126,000 Singaporeans, only 8.4% of Malays have used their SkillsFuture Credits.

sections.label: Digital Learning@MTS launch
sections.summary: Digital Learning@MTS was launched on 18 February 2017 with 150 Primary 4 and 5 students at three MTS centres.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
sentences.text: Digital Learning@MTS was recently launched on 18 February 2017 with 150 Primary 4 and Primary 5 students at three MTS centres.

sections.label: Future First programme students
sections.summary: Starting with about 150 students, the Future First programme takes a skills-based approach to developing competencies including critical thinking, communication and IT skills.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
sentences.text: Starting with about 150 students, the Future First programme will take a skills-based approach to developing competencies, such as critical thinking, communication and IT skills.

sections.label: Vista Sakinah marriage programme
sections.summary: MSF partners PPIS on Vista Sakinah, launched in 2011, providing marriage education and support for remarrying couples and stepfamilies.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
sentences.text: The Ministry of Social and Family Development (MSF) partners Persatuan Pemudi Islam Singapura (PPIS), on the Vista Sakinah programme.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
sentences.text: Launched in 2011, Vista Sakinah provides specialised marriage education and support programmes for remarrying couples and stepfamilies.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
sentences.text: Since its inception, more than 1,600 couples have benefited from the remarriage preparation programme and more than 1,200 families have benefited from the post-marriage support.

sections.label: Mandatory ARS registration
sections.summary: The Mandatory ARS took effect on 1 January 2017, covering all asatizahs including Quran teachers, with over 2,500 registered to date.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
sentences.text: The Mandatory ARS came into effect on 1 January 2017 and now covers all asatizahs, including Quran teachers.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
sentences.text: To date, more than 2,500 asatizahs and Quran teachers have registered under this initiative.

sections.label: Madrasah PSLE eligibility rate
sections.summary: In 2016, 98% of madrasah students who sat for the PSLE were eligible for a secondary school course, up from 91% in 2012.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
sentences.text: In 2016, 98% of madrasah students who sat for the Primary School Leaving Examination (PSLE) were eligible for a secondary school course, up from 91% in 2012.

sections.label: Madrasah secular subjects funding
sections.summary: The Government set aside up to $1.5 million annually to train madrasah teachers of secular subjects and reward students, with about 350 new awards from this year.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
sentences.text: In his National Day Rally speech in 2015, the Prime Minister announced that our Government would strengthen the teaching of secular subjects in the six full-time madrasahs.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
sentences.text: I am pleased to announce that the Government has set aside up to $1.5 million annually to support the training of madrasah teachers who teach secular subjects and provide incentives to encourage madrasah students who do well in secular subjects.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
sentences.text: Students can now look forward to about 350 new awards being given out for good performance from this year onwards.

sections.label: New campus design update
sections.summary: The new campus will have up-to-date IT infrastructure and facilities to aid learning and is estimated to cost about $17 million.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
sentences.text: Mr Saktiandi Supaat asked for an update on the design of the campus.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
sentences.text: This new campus will have up-to-date IT infrastructure and facilities to aid learning and is estimated to cost about $17 million.

sections.label: Muslim institution proposals consultation
sections.summary: The proposals reinforce Muslim institutions, enhance management of Muslim assets and strengthen Muslim families, and will be put up for public consultation on 14 March.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
sentences.text: The proposals seek to reinforce Muslim institutions, enhance the management of Muslim assets and further strengthen Muslim families.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
sentences.text: We will be putting up the draft proposals for public consultations on Tuesday, 14 March.

sections.label: Committee for PMET employment
sections.summary: A committee co-chaired by Parliamentary Secretaries Assoc Prof Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim and Mr Amrin Amin will be formed to help PMETs address employment challenges.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
sentences.text: To that end, a committee co-chaired by Parliamentary Secretaries Assoc Prof Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim and Mr Amrin Amin will be formed to help PMETs, in particular, to address employment challenges.

sections.label: Funding for madrasah secular teaching
sections.summary: The Government allocated up to $1.5 million per year to support training of madrasah teachers of secular subjects and incentives for students who excel in them.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
sentences.text: Today, I am pleased to announce that the Government has allocated up to $1.5 million per year to support the training of madrasah teachers who teach secular subjects and to provide incentives to students who excel in secular subjects.

sections.label: New Toa Payoh building
sections.summary: The new building, costing about $17 million, will be built in Toa Payoh and equipped with the latest IT infrastructure.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
sentences.text: Costing about $17 million, the new building will be built in Toa Payoh and will be equipped with the latest IT infrastructure.

sections.label: MBMF contributions and AMLA updates
sections.summary: Community contributions to MBMF remain healthy after last year's rate revisions, and AMLA will be updated to empower the family and community assets.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
sentences.text: The community's contributions to MBMF are still healthy after the contribution rates were revised last year.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
sentences.text: AMLA will also be updated so that the institution of the family is empowered, our community's assets are enhanced and the administration of our institutions is strengthened.

sections.label: Singapore Muslim community progress
sections.summary: The Singapore Muslim community stands strong after 52 years through its can-do spirit, institutions, mutual care and partnership with the Government.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
sentences.text: Our Singapore Muslim community can be proud of how far we have come over the past 52 years.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
sentences.text: Today, we stand strong because of our can-do spirit and strong Muslim institutions.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
sentences.text: We stand strong because, as a community, we work together and care for one another.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
sentences.text: By building a resilient and confident community that stands united with the rest of Singapore and in partnership with the Government, we shall overcome whatever challenges that come our way.

sections.label: Tuition classes in CCs
sections.summary: Stopping all tuition classes in CCs will remove access to affordable services that some residents and students legitimately need.

sentences.speaker: The Minister, Prime Minister's Office (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
sentences.text: Stopping the conduct of all tuition classes in CCs will remove access to affordable services that some residents and students legitimately need.

sections.label: Recognised schools of Islamic thought
sections.summary: All legitimate schools of thought recognised under the OIC will be considered, including the Jafari Shia group.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
sentences.text: On the second question, we will consider all legitimate schools of thought which are recognised under the Organisation of Islamic Cooperation (OIC).

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
sentences.text: For example, I have already mentioned in my response on mandatory ARS that we will look also to include the Jafari Shia group which is recognised by OIC.

sections.label: Support for Madrasah Wak Tanjong
sections.summary: MUIS and Madrasah Wak Tanjong have worked out details, with the first principle being that the madrasah continues to exist.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
sentences.text: There are details which have been worked out between MUIS and the Madrasah Wak Tanjong.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
sentences.text: But suffice for me to say that our first principle is to ensure that Madrasah Wak Tanjong continues to exist.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
sentences.text: So, whatever support we have given to the Joint Madrasah System (JMS) madrasahs is also extended to the other three remaining madrasahs.

sections.label: Volunteering happiness and senior participation
sections.summary: Among weekly volunteers, 16% of the study group felt very happy, and MCCY is asked how it partners others to encourage senior volunteering.

sentences.speaker: Ms Joan Pereira (Tanjong Pagar)
sentences.text: Among weekly volunteers, 16% of those in the study group felt very happy, an increase in happiness comparable to having an income of US$75,000−$100,000 versus US$20,000.

sentences.speaker: Ms Joan Pereira (Tanjong Pagar)
sentences.text: How is MCCY partnering senior citizens, SSOs and corporations to encourage more seniors to actively participate in volunteering and charity work?

sections.label: Removing 80-20 rule for IPCs
sections.summary: The passage asks whether there are plans to provide help and remove the 80 is to 20 Fund Raising Rule for local IPCs with overseas projects.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Can the Minister share if there are plans to provide this help and, in particular, to remove the 80 is to 20 Fund Raising Rule for local IPCs which have projects overseas?

sections.label: Religious institutions under SGSecure
sections.summary: The passage states that under SGSecure, religious institutions and leaders must ensure congregation safety and help the community stay united and recover from attacks.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alex Yam (Marsiling-Yew Tee)
sentences.text: As part of SGSecure, religious institutions and religious leaders need to ensure the safety of congregations and also play a larger role in helping others in the community so that society remains united and can recover quickly from any potential terrorist attack.

sections.label: Ministry working with religious leaders
sections.summary: The passage asks how the Ministry will work with religious leaders to enhance community resilience and prepare religious organisations for possible crises.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alex Yam (Marsiling-Yew Tee)
sentences.text: Can the Minister, therefore, share how the Ministry will work with our religious leaders to enhance community resilience and for religious organisations to be prepared for possible crises?

sections.label: Involving madrasah students nationally
sections.summary: The passage expresses hope that the Ministry will involve students from schools like madrasahs in national platforms and programmes for meaningful interaction and diverse views.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: In ensuring a good mix of students, I also hope that the Ministry intends to involve students from schools like the madrasahs in various national platforms and programmes so that there are meaningful interaction and exposure to a diversity of views amongst our youths.

sections.label: Helping tertiary students build resilience
sections.summary: The passage asks how MCCY and NYC with tertiary institutes can help students develop resilience, widen career choices, do internships, network and pursue further studies.

sentences.speaker: Mr Kwek Hian Chuan Henry
sentences.text: How can MCCY and the National Youth Council (NYC), in conjunction with tertiary educational institutes, help our tertiary students develop this resilience in the face of changing job realities?

sentences.speaker: Mr Kwek Hian Chuan Henry
sentences.text: How can we encourage our youths to widen their career path selections, embark on internships and networking, and to pursue further studies to gather deep skills?

sections.label: Reserved Presidential Election and meritocracy
sections.summary: The passage states that the decision to have a reserved Presidential Election for the Malay community has compromised the principle of meritocracy to a certain extent.

sentences.speaker: Mr Muhamad Faisal Bin Abdul Manap
sentences.text: The decision to have a reserved Presidential Election for the Malay community, to me and also to many, has, to a certain extent, compromised the principle of meritocracy.

sections.label: Malay representation and tudung concerns
sections.summary: A Member says the Malay community wants representation across Singaporean life and is concerned Muslim ladies cannot wear the tudung in uniformed groups.

sentences.speaker: Mr Muhamad Faisal Bin Abdul Manap
sentences.text: Minister Yaacob said, I quote, "The Malay community is concerned not just about the President but also Malay Permanent Secretary, Malay General because we want to see representation across the entire Singaporean life." To add on to the Minister's point, I would also like to say that the Malay/Muslim community is also concerned about Muslim ladies not being able to wear the tudung while serving in our uniformed groups − SAF, Home Team and nursing.

sections.label: NAC grant withdrawal and arts climate
sections.summary: A Member says NAC withdrew the grant for The Art of Charlie Chan Hock Chye, risking self-censorship, and cites survey values.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: The Art of Charlie Chan Hock Chye is a wonderful Singapore graphic novel that has won many, many local and international awards over the past one-and-a-half years and, yet, the National Arts Council (NAC) withdrew its publishing grant, citing that, "…it's re-telling of Singapore's history potentially undermines the authority or legitimacy of the Government and its public institutions".

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: Managing the arts sector in this way risks creating a climate of self-censorship and politicisation of the arts.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: The same survey that I cited showed 59% of Singaporeans valuing "being just and fair to all" and 52% valuing "being progressive".

sections.label: Arts access for lower-income families
sections.summary: A Member asks about Ministry efforts to keep arts and heritage accessible to lower-income families who may worry about time and cost.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: Parents from these families may worry about time and cost in engaging in what may be perceived as enrichment and non-essential programmes.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: I would, therefore, like to know more about the Ministry's efforts in place to continue making arts and heritage accessible to those from lower-income families.

sections.label: MCCY arts access measures
sections.summary: A Member asks what measures MCCY has to ensure arts and heritage programmes are accessible to lower-income and disadvantaged groups.

sentences.speaker: Ms Joan Pereira
sentences.text: What measures does MCCY have to ensure that our arts and heritage programmes are accessible to the lower-income and disadvantaged groups?

sections.label: ActiveSG and Friendship Grant numbers
sections.summary: A Member states ActiveSG has facilitated bookings and registrations for close to 1.2 million members and asks about Friendship Grant take-up.

sentences.speaker: Mr Melvin Yong Yik Chye (Tanjong Pagar)
sentences.text: Since its launch, ActiveSG has facilitated booking of sports facilities and registering for Healthy Lifestyle programmes for close to 1.2 million members.

sentences.speaker: Mr Melvin Yong Yik Chye (Tanjong Pagar)
sentences.text: For the past three years, how many people have successfully tapped on the Friendship Grant to initiate sports activities in their communities?

sections.label: DSMP take-up and inclusive gyms
sections.summary: A Member asks about the DSMP take-up rate, how many benefited, and the number and average usage of inclusive gyms in Singapore.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lim Wee Kiak
sentences.text: What is the take-up rate for DSMP as well as how many have benefited from this Master Plan?

sentences.speaker: Dr Lim Wee Kiak
sentences.text: How many inclusive gyms are there in Singapore and what is the average usage?

sections.label: Sports halls opened for sharing
sections.summary: The Ministry shared that 15 more sports halls have been opened for public sharing with MOE collaboration.

sentences.speaker: Mr Melvin Yong Yik Chye
sentences.text: At last year's Committee of Supply (COS), the Ministry shared that 15 more sports halls have been opened for sharing with the public through the collaboration with the Ministry of Education (MOE).

sections.label: National Stadium rental challenges
sections.summary: Media reports cited challenges for event organisers and NSAs securing the National Stadium, with rental fee a factor.

sentences.speaker: Mr Muhamad Faisal Bin Abdul Manap
sentences.text: Our current National Stadium is built on a public-private partnership model.

sentences.speaker: Mr Muhamad Faisal Bin Abdul Manap
sentences.text: Within this period, there had been media reports citing challenges faced by event organisers as well as some of our national sports associations (NSAs), such as the Football Association of Singapore (FAS), to secure the National Stadium for our football matches involving our national team.

sentences.speaker: Mr Muhamad Faisal Bin Abdul Manap
sentences.text: There was also a media report on what the Ministry of Defence (MINDEF), as the NDP organiser, had to go through challenging negotiations with Sports Hub Pte Ltd for the 2016 NDP.

sentences.speaker: Mr Muhamad Faisal Bin Abdul Manap
sentences.text: I understand one of the challenging factors faced by the event organisers and our NSAs is the rental fee.

sections.label: FAS Council election delay
sections.summary: FAS postponed its first Council election in 30 years to before May, prompting questions on date and delay causes.

sentences.speaker: Mr Muhamad Faisal Bin Abdul Manap
sentences.text: As reported in the media on 8 November 2016, FAS had an extraordinary general meeting (EGM) a day before, which was on 7 November, and the meeting had decided to postpone its first-ever election of the Council for 30 years to a date before May this year.

sentences.speaker: Mr Muhamad Faisal Bin Abdul Manap
sentences.text: Can the Ministry share the exact date for the FAS Council election and, two, what causes the delay in the election of the FAS Council?

sentences.speaker: Mr Ganesh Rajaram (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: In October last year, we sank to our lowest ever world ranking of 171.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ganesh Rajaram (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: Currently, we are at 164 and things do not look like they are going to get better anytime soon.

sections.label: Ganesan as FAS Chairman
sections.summary: Mr Ganesan chaired FAS from 1974 to 1981 and was credited with achievements including Malaysia Cup wins.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ganesh Rajaram (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: Mr Ganesan was Chairman of FAS from 1974 to 1981.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ganesh Rajaram (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: He was credited with numerous achievements, including winning the Malaysia Cup in 1977 and 1980, starting the Lion City Cup tournament for the under 16s, inspiring the Kallang Roar at the National Stadium by building a national team that was feared in the region.

sections.label: Mah Bow Tan oversaw FAS
sections.summary: Former Cabinet Minister Mr Mah Bow Tan oversaw FAS for 13 years, from 1991 to 2004.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ganesh Rajaram (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: All of these were under the leadership of one individual, former Cabinet Minister Mr Mah Bow Tan, who oversaw FAS for a period of 13 years, from 1991 to 2004.

sections.label: 1996 S-League grand final
sections.summary: The 1996 S-League grand final was played at the National Stadium before 30,000 fans.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ganesh Rajaram (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: The 1996 S-League grand final was played at the National Stadium between Geylang International and the Singapore Armed Forces Football Club (SAFFC) in front of 30,000 fans!

sections.label: Kyra Poh indoor skydiving medals
sections.summary: Kyra Poh won junior freestyle gold at the 2016 FAI World Cup of Indoor Skydiving and was crowned world's fastest flyer at the Wind Games in Spain.

sentences.speaker: Mr Darryl David (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: Take the case of Kyra Poh, the indoor skydiver who captured a gold medal in the junior freestyle category at the Federation Aeronautique Internationale (FAI) World Cup of Indoor Skydiving in October 2016 and who was recently crowned as the "world's fastest flyer" at the Wind Games in Spain.

sections.label: Asian Winter Games figure skaters
sections.summary: Both did well at the Asian Winter Games in Japan, and Shuran became the first Singaporean to qualify for the World Figure Skating Championships.

sentences.speaker: Mr Darryl David (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: Both did well at the recent Asian Winter Games in Japan and Shuran has become the first Singaporean to qualify for the World Figure Skating Championships at the end of the month.

sentences.speaker: Mr Darryl David (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: With the sport due to feature in the SEA Games in Malaysia this year for the first time, I am confident that both these young ladies will do us proud if they are going to be competing.

sections.label: Fundraising body for local talents
sections.summary: The speaker suggests MCCY set up an organisation for fundraising and sponsorships so local talents can concentrate on their work.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lim Wee Kiak
sentences.text: While the Government may not be able to continue to give more financial support to athletes and artists, more can be done to rally the community, the commercial and philanthropic sectors to provide resources needed for their training and competitions.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lim Wee Kiak
sentences.text: I would suggest for MCCY to set up an organisation dedicated to fundraising and securing sponsorships to help our local talents so that they can concentrate on what they do best.

sections.label: Singapore Hour showcasing attractions
sections.summary: The speaker proposes a Singapore Hour showcasing attractions, festive celebrations, food, and sport events like the F1 Grand Prix.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lim Wee Kiak
sentences.text: I think Singapore should learn from all these.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lim Wee Kiak
sentences.text: We should have a "Singapore Hour" that showcases attractions, our multicultural festive celebrations, our huge diversity of food from the street, from our hawkers or the Michelin-starred restaurants, our sport events like Formula One (F1) Singapore Grand Prix as well as Dragon Boat Regatta.

sections.label: Space for local artists
sections.summary: The speaker asks whether MCCY offers artists space like JTC's Block 71 and requests a report on progress and hurdles.

sentences.speaker: Mr Yee Chia Hsing (Chua Chu Kang)
sentences.text: Some of these artists thus have to either operate out of their own homes or rent small spaces in various locations.

sentences.speaker: Mr Yee Chia Hsing (Chua Chu Kang)
sentences.text: This is not ideal, as being scattered all over makes it difficult for the public to view the works of various artists in one location.

sentences.speaker: Mr Yee Chia Hsing (Chua Chu Kang)
sentences.text: JTC has set aside Block 71 and two nearby blocks at Ayer Rajah Crescent as a launchpad for local startups, offering space for these startups at lower rental rates to help them.

sentences.speaker: Mr Yee Chia Hsing (Chua Chu Kang)
sentences.text: Does MCCY currently offer something similar for our local artists?

sentences.speaker: Mr Yee Chia Hsing (Chua Chu Kang)
sentences.text: If not, can the Ministry consider taking over some unused Government buildings, such as former school premises, for this purpose?

sentences.speaker: The Chairman

sentences.speaker: Mr Kok Heng Leun (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: I have no doubt of Ms Rosa's credentials which put her in good stead for the job, but her multiple posts beg the question as to how she will manage all of them, given the time and energy they require.

sections.label: Heritage Involvement Programme proposal
sections.summary: A speaker asks the Government to weave culture into the school curriculum through a Heritage Involvement Programme, citing students who recorded traditional instrument sounds.

sentences.speaker: Mr Darryl David
sentences.text: Can we not engage in experimentation via projects, such as the one undertaken by five Republic Polytechnic's Diploma in Sonic Arts students in 2015?

sentences.speaker: Mr Darryl David
sentences.text: They then recorded notes played using the dholak, an Indian drum, and 24 other traditional Indian, Malay and Chinese instruments featured on a special edition SG50-themed electronic keyboard.

sentences.speaker: Mr Darryl David
sentences.text: Team leader Azurah Jan Che Onn Azahar saw it important to have all the sounds saved, "so future generations will know the music of the cultures of Singapore".

sentences.speaker: Mr Darryl David
sentences.text: These are just two aspects of our uniquely Singapore heritage, but there is more, so much more.

sentences.speaker: Mr Darryl David
sentences.text: I would thus like to ask the Government if a better understanding of culture can be woven into our school curriculum through a Heritage Involvement Programme in which students spend a stipulated number of hours each year being exposed to various aspects of Singaporean culture and heritage.

sentences.speaker: Mr Darryl David
sentences.text: For us to remain singularly Singaporean, let us invest in our culture and heritage, because I believe that it is only through a deep appreciation and understanding of our culture and heritage that we can continue to strengthen and enhance our Singaporean identity.

sentences.text: The Silver Volunteer Fund supports volunteer programmes involving seniors, including the training, management and recognition of senior volunteers.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: Over 500 leaders from nearly 180 organisations were briefed on how to develop crisis management plans and ways to keep their followers safe.

sentences.text: By 2020, students from all secondary schools will have the opportunity to attend a five-day OBS expedition.

sentences.text: Last year, Kah Chun won the prestigious Gustav Mahler Conducting Competition in Germany.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien

sentences.text: When the new Stamford Arts Centre is ready in 2018, it is envisioned to be a vibrant space for the performing arts, especially traditional arts.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: That is why in 2015, MCCY set up the Culture Academy to nurture the next generation of cultural leadership in the public sector.

sections.label: Cultural Diplomacy Fund and Venice Biennale

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: In 2014, MCCY established the Cultural Diplomacy Fund (CDF) to raise the international profile of Singapore artists and cultural institutions and to grow our diplomatic space by showcasing the "softer side" of Singapore.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: They also profile cultural excellence beyond our shores, strengthen capabilities and develop markets for Singapore's culture sector.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: This year, Singapore will be represented at the Venice Biennale with multidisciplinary artist Zai Kuning's showcase Dapunta Hyang: Transmission of Knowledge, a culmination of over 20 years of research on Malay culture and history in Southeast Asia.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: Works like Zai's, which will be in Venice from 13 May to 26 November, will help to profile Singapore artists both at home and abroad.

sections.label: Empress Place archaeological excavation
sections.summary: The 2015 Empress Place excavation uncovered 3.5 tonnes of artefacts suggesting 14th century Temasek was an international trading hub.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: Members may recall the 2015 archaeological excavation at Empress Place.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: We uncovered some 3.5 tonnes of artefacts from 14th century Singapore or, more accurately, Temasek.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: The 300 to 500 copper coins from different time periods in imperial China, 12th century Ceylon, and coins used by the Dutch East India Company, suggest that 14th century Temasek had been a well-established international trading hub.

sentences.text: Singaporeans will also be invited to provide their views on the Plan later this year at public roadshows, online platforms and other channels.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: We target to publish the first edition of the Heritage Plan in early 2018, with an update every five years.

sentences.text: As we announced last year, we will continue to progressively open up all remaining indoor sports halls and fenced fields in Government primary and secondary schools by around 2020.

sentences.text: We will initiate around 20 SIP projects across the island by 2020, supported by a budget of $50 million.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: The Government currently provides about $45 million annually in funding to NSAs, which marks a slight increase over the previous years.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: We urge FAS to conduct the election soon.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: The second programme, Company of Good Fellowship, aims to grow a community of corporate leaders and develop their capabilities in leadership and corporate giving, through targeted training, mentoring and networking opportunities.

sections.label: Foreign fundraising charitable purposes rule

sentences.text: With regard to fundraising for foreign charitable purposes, at least 80% of funds collected by both IPCs and non-IPCs must go towards charitable purposes in Singapore.

sections.label: MCCY youth development support
sections.summary: MCCY helps youths chart paths from school to work through *SCAPE workshops, career guidance partnerships, financial literacy and mental well-being efforts.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: Our role at MCCY is to grow these strengths in our youths and empower them to chart their own paths as they transit from school to the workplace. *SCAPE, for instance, offers personal development workshops to help youths gain awareness of their aptitude and interests and work towards their future aspirations. *SCAPE also exposes youths early to possibilities in the working world by bringing practitioners from different industries to share about their experiences.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: In addition, we are partnering IHLs, agencies, such as SkillsFuture Singapore and the National Trades Union Congress (NTUC), to enhance career guidance through roadshows, industry talks, mentorship as well as the upcoming MySkillsFuture portal.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: To help them plan, save and realise their aspirations, we have been working with the Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS), the Ministry of Manpower (MOM) and other agencies to equip them with basic financial literacy and planning skills.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: We are also partnering NurtureSG and the Ministry of Health (MOH) on youth mental well-being and self-care, as it is important for our youths to maintain a sense of perspective and stay balanced in the face of challenges.

sections.label: OSU overseas Singaporeans return

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: OSU coordinates the various Government channels to facilitate the return of Overseas Singaporeans and ease in the transition.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: It is not easy to bring 40,000 students through the galleries.
